name: Horror: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Horror look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, horror film still, subject half lost in shadow, something wrong at the edge of the frame, decayed textures, uneasy off-centre composition, low-key lighting, single cold practical light, desaturated palette with one sickly accent colour, fog
